description: Independently verify an AgentGuard signed receipt. Returns valid true/false. Tampering with any signed field makes verification fail. Optional agent_id, task_id and workflow_id accept identifiers only; spend_decide binds them into the signed actor. Read-only and cost-configuration tools accept these fields without recording a spend decision.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identifier; signed as actor.agentId on spend_decide

public_key_hex.description: Signer public key (64 hex characters). Defaults to this server signer.

receipt_json.description: The signed receipt entry as a JSON string

task_id.description: Optional task identifier; signed as actor.taskId on spend_decide

workflow_id.description: Optional workflow identifier; signed as actor.workflowId on spend_decide

name: verify_receipt
